content:
Alex Chen: Hey folks — need backup for an onsite candidate this Friday 11:00 AM PST. Panel as planned: Infra (Elena), ML (Samir), Product (Priya). Need a scribe and someone to own the debrief. Also quick question: are we locking rubric weights for System Design vs Culture for this hire? Current rubric: https://redwood.internal/rubrics/senior-inference.md :thinking_face:

Priya Kapoor: I can do debrief lead if I'm remote and not on call. Happy to scribe too but would prefer to lead the debrief.

Samir Patel: I can shift things around, I’ll be a panelist. Regarding weights — last doc had SD=60, Execution=25, Culture=15. But happy to revisit for cross-functional role.

Elena Morris: I’m out Friday morning until ~10:30 PT. I can join after 11:30 if we push. If not, I can send succinct notes right after.

Jordan R: I can scribe if needed.

Alex Chen: @CalendarBot could you create a tentative event for Fri 11:00 PST and add recording consent in the invite? Also add a backup interviewer slot in case Samir needs to drop.

CalendarBot: Created event "Candidate: A. Smith — Senior Inference Engineer" Fri 11:00 AM PST. Invite: https://calendar.internal/e/abc123. Recording consent: pending (action required). Backup slot added.

Priya Kapoor: Quick debrief checklist we use — copy/paste for scribe:
```
- 5m: intros + expectations
- 35m: interview
- 10m: buffer/questions
- 15m: debrief (scribe runs)
- Scribe: capture rubric scores + 2-3 concrete evidence bullets per section
```

Alex Chen: Note: rubric updated to call out a new SD subpoint: "cost/latency tradeoffs" — please call that out during evaluation.

Maya K: Re: weights — Product would like a bit more behavioral emphasis since role ships across teams. Proposal: SD=50, Execution=30, Culture=20. Thoughts?

Samir Patel: I can work with 50/30/20. Seems reasonable.

Priya Kapoor: 50/30/20 works for me. Alex, can you update the rubric doc and attach the take-home/prompt so panelists can preview?

Alex Chen: Done — updated rubric: https://redwood.internal/rubrics/senior-inference-2026.md (added cost/latency bullet). I also attached a 2-line scribe template to the calendar event and added the take-home prompt link.

Elena Morris: If we keep 11:00 I’ll join after 11:30 and submit a short debrief note. If we can nudge to 11:30 that’d be ideal.

Jordan R: Confirmed — I’ll scribe and capture timestamped examples. Will post notes to the candidate thread within 30m after debrief.

Alex Chen: Final asks: @People Ops please confirm recording consent checkbox is in the invite and that backup interviewer is on standby. Also add a brief reminder to the panel 24h before. :thumbsup:

People Ops: Added recording consent checkbox in the invite, backup interviewer slot marked, and reminder scheduled for 24h prior. :white_check_mark:

Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turn. I’ll follow up if we push to 11:30.
